n0.hypothesis: Construct an exact uniform polynomial scalar source for PA; score finite DAG improvements without equating them to a proof
n0.insight:
[from n1] A compact spectral or rational generating function is usable only when its input moments and final contraction are constructed as scalar gates; both must be included in any source claim.
[from n3] Lifting the characteristic-two image needs a closed scalar representation of all correction interactions; polynomial precision length, or efficient computation of an individual correction, does not by itself supply one.
[from n2] A compact local fusion rule must include its accumulated mixed terms and scalar contraction; preservation of each separate direction does not establish closure of their superposition.
[from n4] Input-dependent coordinate changes can remove whole collision classes with polynomial scalar cost, but their remaining simultaneous-collision corrections require a uniform formula, not a finite list of low-degree cancellations.
[from n5] Adaptive representations must be tested against their algebraic identities, not only parameter counts. Low-order determinant representations can exist without a closed update to all orders.
[from n6] Implicit polynomial solvers are useful only when every equation coefficient has a counted source circuit. A proved solver and a unique formal solution do not permit hiding smaller permanents inside the system data.

n1.hypothesis: The global collision projector can be compiled through an input-dependent rational generating function with a polynomial closed recurrence and exact terminal evaluation
n1.insight:
Polynomial collision spectrum and compact cumulants do not compute their initial amplitudes; diagonal rational resummation removes loops but retains overlaps of longer cycles.
[from n4] Input-dependent coordinate changes can remove whole collision classes with polynomial scalar cost, but their remaining simultaneous-collision corrections require a uniform formula, not a finite list of low-degree cancellations.

metadata.result: Exact source compiler saves n redundant multiplications; 56 frozen development checks pass. Global collision, Bell and rational substitutions supply no polynomial final readout. Commit contains exact verifiers and proofs.

n2.hypothesis: A nonlinear representation built from row factors and adapted to the known suffix admits polynomial fusion and direct scalar readout
n2.insight:
Individual jet directions stay rank one under exchange, but pivot multipliers generate mixed connected interactions; a scalar final contraction needs a representation carrying these interactions.
[from n5] Adaptive representations must be tested against their algebraic identities, not only parameter counts. Low-order determinant representations can exist without a closed update to all orders.

metadata.result: Exact division-free pivot-jet compiler passes56 frozen development cases; size4*3^(n-1)-3*2^n+2n^2+n, no improvement over baseline. Rank-one exchange proved, mixed interactions computed exactly.

n3.hypothesis: The polynomial characteristic-two determinant source lifts uniformly to characteristic zero with polynomial overhead
n3.insight:
Each inversion correction weight can be computed polynomially, but a polynomial contraction over all partial matchings is still required. Fourier diagonalization has exponential support even after row and column parity constraints.
[from n6] Implicit polynomial solvers are useful only when every equation coefficient has a counted source circuit. A proved solver and a unique formal solution do not permit hiding smaller permanents inside the system data.

metadata.result: Exact lifting and Gaussian-weight identities checked; no scalar compiler submitted. Verified lift/Jacobi instances, marked inversion expansions, polar rank formulas and quadratic Gauss sums.

n4.hypothesis: An input-dependent implicit univariate substitution with a Lagrange-Good Jacobian removes repeated cycles while preserving a polynomial scalar recurrence
n4.insight: Input-dependent Schur normalization kills every occupancy with exactly one repeated index. Pair and higher simultaneous repetitions remain, and fixed-degree corrections do not yet form a closed polynomial family.

metadata.result: Polynomial implicit Schur-Good scalar compiled and identities proved. General readout fails: degree4 and5 corrections explicit, but corrected all-ones size6 gives260 instead of720. Candidate remains n1 exact exponential source.

n5.hypothesis: Flag permanents admit a polynomially constructible principal-minor matrix representation with a scalar determinant readout and closed row update
n5.insight: Flag permanents and principal minors have equal parameter dimension but different identities. A separate matrix at each layer remains possible, while rank-i and demonstrated determinant-mixture repairs do not close polynomially.

metadata.result: Exact n4 certificates disprove a shared principal-minor encoding, even for proper layers. Full-rank layer2 and two-determinant layer3 identities verified symbolically. No general scalar candidate.

n6.hypothesis: Permanent and its first adjugate satisfy a polynomial closed implicit lifting system with a nonsingular characteristic-two initial Jacobian
n6.insight: Newton precision doubling and a nonsingular explicit Jacobian are available. The required permanent/Dodgson defect coefficient circuits remain the source problem; their tested recursion has exponentially many distinct states even after sharing.

metadata.result: Exact n^2+1 variable Newton system executed at n3,n4. Conditional compiler size O(s*n^2+n^4), where s includes all H,K coefficient circuits. Shared-index closures counted exactly; no polynomial coefficient closure obtained.
